parameters.jsCode: const d=$json; const keywords=String(d['Search Keywords']||d['Search Keywords ']||'').trim(); const sortRaw=String(d['Sort By']||d['Sort By ']||'latest').toLowerCase(); const dateRaw=String(d['Date Posted Filter']||d['Date Posted Filter ']||'past month').toLowerCase(); const sortBy=/top|match|relev|best/.test(sortRaw)?'relevance':'date_posted'; const datePosted=/24/.test(dateRaw)?'past-24h':/week/.test(dateRaw)?'past-week':'past-month'; return [{json:{constructedUrl:`https://www.linkedin.com/search/results/content/?keywords=${encodeURIComponent(keywords)}&datePosted=${encodeURIComponent(datePosted)}&sortBy=${encodeURIComponent(sortBy)}&origin=FACETED_SEARCH`}}];

messageValues.message: Write three progressive LinkedIn outreach messages under 300 characters each. Keep them casual, human, relevant to the post, non-pushy, and aligned to the sender's tone and goal. Return only JSON with message_1, message_2 and message_3.

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().map(i=>{try{let t=String(i.json.text||'').replace(/^```json\s*/i,'').replace(/```$/,'').trim(); const p=JSON.parse(t.match(/{[\s\S]*}/)?.[0]||t); return {json:{message_1:p.message_1,message_2:p.message_2,message_3:p.message_3}};}catch(e){return {json:{error:'Failed to parse generated messages'}}}});
